summary: Reproduction scope covers the paper's ADMM/Laplacian method and all four real-data case studies with the published baselines.

claims.statement: Laplacian-regularized stratified fitting can be solved by alternating local proximal updates and Laplacian consensus systems, with parallelizable local work.
claims.comparison_conditions: Use the same local objectives and graph weights while varying graph coupling; product-grid matvec must agree with an explicit small Cartesian-product Laplacian.

claims.statement: Sex-by-age Laplacian regularization improves mesothelioma logistic prediction over separate models and is competitive with the common model.
claims.comparison_conditions: 90/10 random split with seed 0, diagnosis-method leakage removed, categorical feature engineering and standardization fit on training data.

claims.statement: Geographic Laplacian regularization yields accurate and interpretable house-price models, outperforming the common and separate models and matching the random-forest baseline.
claims.comparison_conditions: Filter longitude <= -121.6, use the paper's nine house features plus intercept, standardize from training data, and use a 75/25 split with seed 0.

claims.statement: State-border and time-path Laplacian regularization improves held-out Senate election probability likelihood over separate and common Bernoulli models.
claims.comparison_conditions: Freeze data through 2016, train on 1976-2012 and test on 2014-2016, with one winner per state-year and epsilon=1e-5 clipping.

claims.statement: A product-graph Poisson stratified model predicts Chicago crime counts better than separate and common models while retaining smooth location and temporal rates.
claims.comparison_conditions: Aggregate all 2017 and 2018 records into every 20x20x52x7x24 cell, retain zero-count cells, train on 2017 and test on 2018.
